$comment: Libraries a widget's screen may import, besides react, react-dom, react-router and shuvix/widget. Read by widgetLibs.ts and scripts/vendor-widget-libs.mjs.
version: must equal what is installed (apps/desktop/package.json pins it; the vendor script refuses a mismatch).
files: globs relative to the package that replace the default selection (package.json, license files, and every .js/.mjs/.cjs/.css outside test, docs, bin and examples folders).

served: not bundled into widgets. The widget server serves the vendored files (minified when vendored) under /w/<id>/lib/<name>@<version>/, and the page's import map points each specifier (a key ending in / is a prefix) at its file or folder.
exportTypes: devDependencies an exported Vite project adds when the widget imports the library.
blocked: exact specifiers the bundler refuses, with the hint it gives.
dependencyFiles: file globs for dependencies pulled in by the libraries (keys may end in *).
skipDependencies: dependencies that no browser entry point imports (command-line tools, server renderers).

blocked.highlight.js: Importing "highlight.js" bundles every language (about 1 MB). Import "highlight.js/lib/core" and register the languages you need from "highlight.js/lib/languages/<name>".
